title: A Card for the Day
summary: A short grounding, a circle of gold, and a single tarot card drawn to carry with you through the day.
source: Card names follow the Rider-Waite-Smith deck (1909, public domain). Ritual structure original to Virtual Rites.

steps.title: Ground
steps.text: Feel your weight settle. Breathe with the ring of light.
steps.say: Ground yourself. Breathe with the ring.
steps.describe: A pale ring on the ground widens and narrows slowly.

steps.title: Open the circle
steps.text: A ring of gold light encloses the space around you.

steps.title: Draw
steps.text: A card rises from the ground and turns to face you.
steps.describe: A single tarot card rises in front of you and turns face up.

steps.title: {cards}
steps.text: You drew {cards}. What in this card answers your question? Stay as long as you need.

steps.title: Close the circle
steps.text: The card sinks back into the ground. The gold ring fades.

steps.title: Carry it with you
steps.text: Note the card in your journal and see where it shows up today.
